fields.claim: The multilayer CCAg/ITO optics are a class-level NASA transfer, unqualified on beryllium (048) and on CFRP, where deposition, adhesion over a -0.4 ppm/K laminate and matrix outgassing are open. On the 60% Vf face, 048's full-cycle screen reads 0.890 at 037's source geometry (fails) and 1.18 at its own geometry.
fields.needed_to_ground: Measured optics, adhesion and thermal cycling of the finish on the chosen face.
